timezone_policy.device_timezone_rule: Schedules are evaluated strictly against current IST time regardless of traveler device locale.

timetable_states.HAS_UPCOMING: Displays next scheduled departures in IST
timetable_states.NO_MORE_TODAY: Displays 'No more scheduled departures today' when current IST > last departure
timetable_states.UNAVAILABLE: Displays 'Timetable unavailable — No official schedule published' for routes without schedule data

anti_fake_gps_rule: NEVER label scheduled times as live arrival, ETA, or live vehicle tracking.
